exposure: Number of intraplacental echolucent zones on grayscale ultrasound
Number of intraplecental echolucent zones with color flow on color Doppler ultrasound
Size of echolucent zone at non-fetal surface
cohort: 120 pregnant women over 20 weeks of gestational age with anterior placenta and a history of previous cesarean section
finding: Quantitative findings of color Doppler ultrasound, particularly more than two echolucent zones with color flow, have considerable sensitivity and specificity in detecting morbidly adherent placenta.
